title: AiMemoryExportV1
description: ai.memory-export@1 (OpenVibe.AI; Memory M5): the one portable memory file. GET /api/v1/memory/export answers it, decrypted for the person's own export; POST /api/v1/memory/import accepts the same document (only `format`, `version` and `items` are read on import). Every item carries the text after redaction, its kind and scope, its source and the confidence the store had; ids, owners and merge/conflict links are deliberately absent, so a file can be moved to another account and imported without carrying anyone's identity. A profile is derived from the items and is rebuilt, never imported.

exported_at.description: When the file was written. Informational only; import never trusts it as an item time.

text.description: The item text after the store's own redaction. A secret that survived an older export is redacted again on import.

scope.description: `user` for the person, or `project:<slug>` for a project. Never an absolute path.

source.description: The adapter id (claude-code, cursor, …), the service (actor, vibe, know, person) or the memory-service adapter (mem0, letta, zep) the item came from.

source_ref.description: The path relative to the scanned root and the heading, when the item came from a file.

status.description: Defaults to active on import. A conflict item is imported as suggested: its pair did not come with it.

machine.description: The Link machine id the item came from, when it came from one.
